name: HPGC Renmintongtai Pharmaceutical Corporation
summary: HPGC Renmintongtai Pharmaceutical Corporation engages in the wholesale and retail of pharmaceutical products in China and internationally. The company offers chemical drugs, traditional Chinese medicine, biological products, and medical supplies; medical instruments, traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces, health foods, daily necessities, glassware, and chemical reagents, etc.; It serves its products through e-commerce platforms, direct sales, and a chain of direct stores and online B2C, O2O, etc. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Harbin, China. HPGC Renmintongtai Pharmaceutical Corporation is a subsidiary of Harbin Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
